title: Tribonacci Numbers That Are Products of Two Lucas Numbers
summary: Let $T_{k}$ be the $k^{\textrm{th}}$ Tribonacci number and $L_{n}$ be the $n^{\textrm{th}}$ Lucas number defined by their respective recurrence relation $T_{k}=T_{k-1}+T_{k-2}+T_{k-3}$ and $L_{n}=L_{n-1}+L_{n-2}$. In this study, we solve the Diophantine equation $T_{k} = L_{m}L_{n}$ for positive integer unknowns $m$, $n$, and $k$ and prove our results.
